Don't get too close.|audio = HardcoreWave23-2.ogg|[[Professor V]] on Wave 23 ([[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Elite Phantom''' is a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy that appears in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] and [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] modes. It is a stronger version of the [[Phantom]], having higher health and faster speed than it. As it is a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy, towers need hidden detection to target it. ==Logbook Description== "''The Elite Phantom has existed long enough to draw in and crush countless others within its core that it has enhanced its natural abilities. The pull around them is stronger, to the point that standing next to one is a sure-fire way to be dragged into an unfortunate end. The sound around them also seems to distort, but it is still not known why.''" ==Appearance== The '''Elite Phantom''' is a translucent ghost with a purple body. In place of its legs, it has a tail, allowing it to float above the path. It wears a purple shirt with a hood, which has three purple crystals on top. ==Strategy== *Due to the '''Elite Phantom's''' fast speed, it is not recommended to use towers with low range against it. **Freezing towers, such as the [[Freezer]], [[Frost Blaster]] and [[Cryomancer]] can be useful at stalling the '''Elite Phantom'''. ***Do note that '''Elite Phantoms''' gain [[Freeze Immunity|Freeze Immunity]] on Wave 35 of [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode. *A Level 4+ [[Ace Pilot]] can be used to give towers without hidden detection, like the [[Kingpin]] hidden detection, allowing them to take this enemy down. *The [[DJ Booth]] and [[Commander]] can be used to help kill '''Elite Phantoms''' quicker. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Concept Art}} ElitePhantomCA.png|'''Elite Phantom''' on its concept art. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} ElitePhantomIconIG.png|'''Elite Phantom''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Elite Phantom''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Elite Phantom''' added, replacing the [[Shadow Boss]]. {{Hardcore|[[Void Reaper]]|Wave 22|Elite Phantom|Wave 23|[[Mandragora]]|Wave 26}} {{Voidcore|[[Voidling]]|Wave 20|Elite Phantom|Wave 22|[[Void Reaper]]|Wave 23}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
